title: Ida Noddack proposes nuclei can split
summary: Chemist Ida Noddack was the first to suggest that bombarded uranium nuclei might break into large fragments, the idea later named fission.
why: Anticipated nuclear fission by four years.

unsung.contribution: First proposed the idea later named nuclear fission.
unsung.recognition: With no experimental proof offered, her paper was generally ignored and mocked.
